A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] '''recruit''' was accepted into the [[New Jedi Order]]<ref name="Twilight" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> The founder of the Order, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], was surprised that a Bith was among the recruits.<ref name="Twilight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bith recruit was mentioned in the novel ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published in [[1997]].<ref name="Twilight" />

*''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' {{1stm}}
